filesPicker.guidingMessage: Please guide me through setting up this new project. This folder was just created with a HANDOFF.md skeleton (and a TaskMaster scaffold if init succeeded). 1) Ask me about the project goal, scope, key deliverables and milestones; 2) Write the conclusions into HANDOFF.md (project description / current task / next steps) and .taskmaster/docs/prd.txt; 3) If TaskMaster init did not succeed, run `npx task-master init -y` first; 4) Finally use TaskMaster's parse-prd to generate the initial task list. Start by asking me your questions.
